title: Procedures for the 5G System (5GS)
tagline: Stage-2 procedures — when SMF requests session policy
summary: TS 23.502 defines the Stage-2 procedures for the 5G System. For the 29.512 story, the critical procedure is PDU Session Establishment (clause 4.3.2): it specifies when the SMF must contact the PCF for session management policy before the session can be fully established and user-plane rules applied.
whyItMatters: 29.512 tells you what the PCF API looks like; 23.502 tells you when SMF must call it during live network procedures. Without this spec, the policy call in the E2E flow has no procedural context.
defines: PDU Session Establishment, Modification, and Release procedures
